what_happened: The job asked for a reading-stage check of each criterion against D43 (behavior evidence must cite commands that ran) and the append-only rules. It was rejected at the final verdict. The verifier gave two major findings and no blockers. No acceptance criteria or checks are listed as unmet or failed. First, the new append-only rule in edits_existing_decision (reading/surveys.rs) matches only imperative edit phrasings. It does not refuse the real criterion of job 20261102-005332-8gkv, which is the instance the request cites, so the class is not prevented. Second, the accepted reading does not match the request, so passing criteria do not show the request was met.
cause: Nothing cross-checked the accepted reading against the request's wording before the final verdict. The new refusal matcher was designed from imagined phrasings and was never replayed against the recorded criterion it was written to catch, from job 20261102-005332-8gkv. It therefore passed its own tests and still missed the cited instance. Nothing required a new rule to catch its named motivating case before the job counted as done.
other_causes: The reading misstated the request, so the criteria could pass without showing the request was met.
Matching was by imperative phrasing, which is brittle against the varied wording real criteria use.
open_hypotheses: The fields do not show how the reading misstated the request, so it is unknown whether it narrowed the request to the D43 check or the append-only check.
The fields do not show whether the producer's tests included the cited criterion text or used invented fixtures.
contradictions: The earlier cases in this class also lacked cross-checks of the reading, but here no failed check or unmet criterion is listed, so the final verdict rested only on the verifier's findings.
prevention: A code check at reading acceptance should require that any new refusal rule is replayed against the recorded criteria of the failed jobs the request cites. It should fail if the named instance, here the criterion of job 20261102-005332-8gkv, is not refused. A second check should compare the reading's stated goal with the request's own words and flag a mismatch before the plan starts.
proposed_request:
Make the reading-stage append-only rule (edits_existing_decision in crates/athena-core/src/reading/surveys.rs) refuse the real criterion of job 20261102-005332-8gkv, and any criterion that amends or rewrites an existing decision record whatever its phrasing. Acceptance:
- A test takes the recorded criterion text of job 20261102-005332-8gkv from the job records and shows the rule refuses it. The test must fail on the current base tree.
- A test replays the rule over the recorded criteria of past jobs and shows that it does not refuse criteria that only add new decision entries.
- The reading restates the request without narrowing it, and keeps the D43 requirement that behavior evidence cite commands that ran.
- cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings and cargo test pass.
- CHANGELOG.md has an entry.
